sources.facts: Broadcom-origin header: mailbox0 POL at RX+0x10 explicitly none-pop read; RX normal read, TX opposite FIFO, EMPTY bit30, FULL bit31. Historical base addresses are NOT used.
brcm,bcm2835-mbox compatible retains RX0, POL0x10, RX status0x18, TX0x20, TX status0x38. Linux's all-message draining IRQ handler is NOT reused.
BCM2712 mailbox uses brcm,bcm2835-mbox; actual current-boot address graph must come from separately checked FDT, not this source tree.

scope: Pure callback-driven transaction only. No MMIO/cache/ARM adapter, framebuffer allocation, format, PA conversion, mapping or ownership is implemented. Future real adapter must establish exclusive current-boot mailbox ownership and linked buffer/cache authority independently.
